summary: Built the full Zafranik premium spices landing page in React (Vite) to match the provided design: navbar, hero with trust bar and torn-edge transition, Explore by Origin arch cards, Bestsellers carousel with custom product photography, Inspiring Recipes panel, Why Zafranik, newsletter, and multi-column footer. Used Cormorant Garamond + Montserrat, burgundy/gold/cream palette, and generated hero/bestsellers assets. Dev server runs at http://localhost:5173; production build succeeds.
current_status: Zafranik React landing page is complete and runnable locally via npm run dev; all major sections from the mockup are implemented and the production build passes.
